readings: For each patient in the Laboratory table, compute their average PIC and their hemoglobin-to-hematocrit ratio, taken as their average `HGB` divided by their average `HCT` (ignoring missing values). Keep the patients whose ratio is above the average of all patients' ratios, and give one summary row for them: the average of their average PIC values, the average of their ratios, and the average amount by which their ratios exceed that all-patient average.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic,
    AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
